description: READ-ONLY: list the user's connected CEX venues (id, exchange slug, label, status, markets) so follow-up reads can target a connectionId. `markets` is spot|futures|both as verified at save (Kraken dual keys; KuCoin/Bitget futures scope) — a row with markets=both covers perpetuals, so prefer it for positions reads. Returns metadata only, never keys or secrets. Call this first when the user asks about positions, balances, or anything per-exchange.
name: list_connections
title: List CEX connections
